title: WEATHER FORECAST FOR 11 FEBRUARY 2026 Issued at 2.00 p.m. on 10 February 2026 The prevailing dry weather conditions are expected to change from 12th February. Mainly dry weather will prevail in the most parts of the island. Misty conditions can be expected at some places in Western, Sabaragamuwa, Central, Uva, North-central and North-western provinces and in Galle and Matara districts during the early hours of the morning.
